findings.evidence: template/scripts/model_routing.py:1240-1243 persists an open, platform-observed delegation before calling run_codex. run_codex calls codex_argv at line 1125, which raises RoutingError when native containment is unavailable (1039-1041), before launching any child. This exception leaves the open delegation persisted with no execution. The early gate accepts any non-null delegation (730-731), and escalate skips the content-divergence check whenever a delegation exists (1009-1017). Consequently, after this failed preflight the supervisor can write content, escalate, and record retained execution despite no child having run.
findings.summary: A Codex preflight failure leaves an open delegation that allows supervisor-written content to bypass the early gate and be finalized as retained execution.
